8c0db100-node-2.raw_text:
1.1 "Agreement" means this Master Service Agreement, including all exhibits, schedules, and amendments
hereto.
1.2 "Confidential Information" means any non-public information disclosed by either Party, whether orally or in
writing, that is designated as confidential.
1.3 "Services" means the professional services described in Section 2.1 and any applicable Statement of
Work.

8c0db100-node-3.summary: SCOPE OF SERVICES. Includes: Description of Services, Change Orders.

8c0db100-node-4.title: Description of Services
8c0db100-node-4.raw_text:
The Vendor shall provide the Services described in each Statement of Work executed under this Agreement.
Vendor shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry
standards.

8c0db100-node-5.raw_text:
Any material change to the scope of Services must be documented in a written change order signed by both
Parties, subject to the fee adjustments in Section 4.3.

8c0db100-node-6.title: FEES AND PAYMENT
8c0db100-node-6.summary: FEES AND PAYMENT. Includes: Payment Obligations, Fee Schedule, Taxes, Disputed Invoices.

8c0db100-node-7.title: Payment Obligations
8c0db100-node-7.raw_text:
Client shall pay all invoiced amounts within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Late payments shall accrue
interest at 1.5% per month, subject to Section 3.4.

8c0db100-node-9.title: Taxes
8c0db100-node-9.raw_text:
All fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, which shall be borne by Client except taxes based on Vendor's net
income.

All fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, which shall be borne by Client except taxes based on Vendor's net

8c0db100-node-10.title: Disputed Invoices
8c0db100-node-10.raw_text:
Client may withhold payment of a disputed amount only if it provides written notice of the dispute within fifteen
(15) days of the invoice date, as further described in Section 6.2 (Notice Requirements).

8c0db100-node-11.title: TERM AND TERMINATION
8c0db100-node-11.summary: TERM AND TERMINATION. Includes: Term, Termination for Cause, Termination for Convenience, Effect of Termination.

8c0db100-node-12.title: Term
8c0db100-node-12.raw_text:
This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twenty-four (24) months,
unless earlier terminated as set forth in this Section 4.
8c0db100-node-12.summary:
This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twenty-four (24) months,

8c0db100-node-13.title: Termination for Cause
8c0db100-node-13.raw_text:
Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other Party materially breaches this
Agreement and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days of receiving notice, subject to the notice
requirements in Section 6.2. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client may terminate immediately for Vendor's
failure to maintain the insurance required under Section 8.1.
8c0db100-node-13.summary: Termination for Cause. Includes: Cure Period Exceptions.

8c0db100-node-14.title: Cure Period Exceptions
8c0db100-node-14.raw_text:
No cure period shall apply to breaches of the confidentiality obligations in Section 7 or to a Party's insolvency,
which shall each constitute grounds for immediate termination.
8c0db100-node-14.summary:
No cure period shall apply to breaches of the confidentiality obligations in Section 7 or to a Party's insolvency,
which shall each constitute grounds for immediate termination.

8c0db100-node-15.title: Termination for Convenience
8c0db100-node-15.raw_text:
Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice. In the event of
termination for convenience, Client shall pay Vendor for all Services performed through the effective date of
termination, together with any non-cancellable costs reasonably incurred, but shall not be liable for lost profits.

8c0db100-node-16.title: Effect of Termination
8c0db100-node-16.raw_text:
Upon termination for any reason: (a) Client shall pay all outstanding fees for Services rendered prior to
termination; (b) each Party shall return or destroy the other Party's Confidential Information; and (c) Sections 3,
5, 7, and 9 shall survive termination.

8c0db100-node-17.raw_text:
5.1 EXCEPT FOR BREACHES OF SECTION 7 (CONFIDENTIALITY), NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE
FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. EACH PARTY'S TOTAL LIABILITY
SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

8c0db100-node-19.title: Method of Notice
8c0db100-node-19.raw_text:
All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by email with confirmation of receipt, or by
certified mail.
8c0db100-node-19.summary:
All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by email with confirmation of receipt, or by

8c0db100-node-20.title: Notice Requirements
8c0db100-node-20.raw_text:
Notices relating to termination or disputed invoices must reference the specific section of this Agreement giving
rise to the notice and must be sent to the address designated in the applicable Statement of Work.

8c0db100-node-21.title: CONFIDENTIALITY
8c0db100-node-21.raw_text:
7.1 Each Party agrees to protect the other Party's Confidential Information using at least the same degree of
care it uses to protect its own confidential information, and in no event less than reasonable care.
7.2 The obligations of this Section 7 shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of five (5) years,
as referenced in Section 4.4(c).

8c0db100-node-22.title: INSURANCE AND INDEMNIFICATION
8c0db100-node-22.summary: INSURANCE AND INDEMNIFICATION. Includes: Insurance, Indemnification.

8c0db100-node-23.title: Insurance
8c0db100-node-23.raw_text:
Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per
occurrence throughout the Term.
8c0db100-node-23.summary:
Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per

8c0db100-node-24.title: Indemnification
8c0db100-node-24.raw_text:
Vendor shall indemnify Client against third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful
misconduct in performing the Services, subject to the limitation of liability in Section 5.1.
